title: Reinstatement Fee Calculation Note for the RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
The reinstatement fee charged when a RentGuard Renters Policy is reinstated is worked out in this order.

**Fee basis.** The fee basis is the tier's reinstatement fee, the reinstatement fee of the policy's RentGuard tier, taken once.

**Reinstatement fee.** The reinstatement fee is the tier's reinstatement fee, rounded half-up to the cent. Any amount added to the fee is added to the fee basis as taken, any relief is then taken off, and the total, never below 0.00, is rounded half-up to the cent once, on the final figure only.

**Tiers without a fee.** A tier whose reinstatement fee is 0.00 charges no reinstatement fee at all; the fee on such a tier is 0.00.

## Reading the fee

| Tier's reinstatement fee | Fee basis taken once | Reinstatement fee |
|---|---|---|
| a positive figure | that figure | that figure, rounded half-up to the cent |
| 0.00 | not used | none (0.00) |

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- A hypothetical tier listing a reinstatement fee of 15.00: the fee basis is 15.00, taken once, and the reinstatement fee is 15.00.
- A hypothetical tier listing a reinstatement fee of 10.00: the fee basis is 10.00, taken once, and the reinstatement fee is 10.00.
- A hypothetical tier listing a reinstatement fee of 0.00: no reinstatement fee is charged, and the fee is 0.00.

The figures above are hypothetical.
